hooks.name: MCP server safety review
hooks.description: On save of mcp-server source, review the change against mainframe-safety steering.

action.prompt: A file under mcp-server/src was just saved. Review the change against the mainframe-safety steering: (1) any path that sends a key or data to the 3270 session without a matching, unexpired, same-screen confirmation; (2) hidden-field values reaching tool output, logs, errors or the audit log; (3) screen text being treated as instructions; (4) any retry that could resend a key. Flag only real problems, citing file and line. If the change is safe, say so in one line.
